title: Chirality and trefoil subgroups
html:
Remark. Chirality and trefoil subgroups

The chirality of the observable universe—manifest in the three colour charges of quantum chromodynamics—is encoded in the symmetry group of the descended surface M_0. genus-maximal descent identifies M_0 as a genus-4 Riemann surface. We require a genus-4 surface whose automorphism group contains three subgroups isomorphic to S_3. These are quotients of the trefoil knot group \pi_1(S^3 \setminus K) \cong \langle x, y \mid x^2 = y^3 \rangle, and they correspond to the three colour charges (red, green, blue). These S_3 subgroups generate a subgroup of the monodromy group. The remaining generators of the full automorphism group act by conjugation, permuting the three S_3 subgroups among themselves.
